description: App Store reviews for one app from App Store Connect: the last 60 days' reviews (up to 25, unanswered first, lowest rating first), each with its rating, title, text, storefront, date, theme and the theme's kind (bug, request, price, praise, other), whether it has an answer and its text, and any reply Apptiller drafted. unanswered counts every review of the 60 days without an answer, beyond the 25 listed. themes counts the last 90 days' reviews per theme with their average rating. ratings: the summary rating and count, new ratings in the last 28 days against the 28 before, downloads and new ratings per 1,000 downloads in each, per version, and advice when the pace fell. key says whether an App Store Connect key reads them. Reviews are read daily on a plan and once a week without one. Read-only: it drafts, sends or withdraws no reply.
name: app_store_reviews
title: App Store reviews
